audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts hand levels 2, 3 and the first-item stage to Vladimir while every 'why' on the same rows says the opposite — whys[1] 'your Parrrley + keg poke out-trades his Transfusion', whys[2] 'he has no Sanguine Pool escape until 6', whys[3] 'You out-trade a pre-Rylai's Vlad', whys[5] 'this is your last clean all-in window'. Levels 4-5 was scored Skill for the same reason.
audit.why: 51.48% over 1354 games with a documented weak-laner: Gangplank owns levels 2 to first item and loses at two items. The packet chart (Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill, Gangplank, Vladimir) matches the prose exactly.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the packet chart, ratings rescaled to match.

audit.why: Content spikes are already keyed correctly: Vlad's HP-cost laning at 1-3, Gangplank's Sheen first-item all-in, level 6 with the caveat that Pool rides out R, and the 2-item inversion at Rylai's/Riftmaker.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer mentions that Tides of Blood is blocked by units. Riot's text is explicit: his E 'deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.'
audit.why: This is the decisive lane interaction and it was absent. Keeping a minion between you and Vladimir removes his only poke tool outright, which is why his early game is losable at all.
audit.corrected: Minion-block written into phases[1].why and tradeGood.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Sanguine Pool' repeated everywhere with no number.
audit.why: Pool is 28s at rank 1 falling to 16s at rank 5, and only 2 seconds of untargetability. That is a huge window to re-engage into and the advice never said so.
audit.corrected: Real 16-28s and 2s figures written into dontsFull[0].d and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] is titled 'Build MR + anti-heal' but its detail was a trading line about wasting Sanguine Pool.
audit.why: The flagged missing interaction is exactly this: Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. Crimson Pact also converts his bonus HP into AP, so raw crit stacking is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal detail written into dosFull[2].d, Crimson Pact into dontsFull[1].d.

edits.before: Q-poke costs him HP and pays you gold. Identify how Vladimir contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: He pays HP, not mana, for Transfusion and Tides of Blood — every step to last-hit is a health bar you can chip.

edits.before: First barrel chains start zoning his wave positions. Only take the trade when Vladimir's Sanguine Pool is down.
edits.after: Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units — keep a minion between you and his only poke tool lands nothing.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vladimir's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage chunks him, but Sanguine Pool rides it out untargetable for 2s — use R to zone or set up your jungler, not as a solo execute.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vladimir carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items flip it: he pools your detonation, drains the chip back, and Rylai's kites your barrels. Close it before then.

edits.before: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Vladimir steps to farm, and orange away whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Vladimir steps to farm, and stand behind a minion so his E is blocked.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Dumping a full keg chain into Sanguine Pool — 2s untargetable eats it and he drains the trade back even.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Oblivion Orb before he stacks HP — Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Vladimir's favourite window — bait the 16-28s pool before you spend a detonation.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crimson Pact turns his HP into AP — take Merc's and MR, not raw crit.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Two AP items and he out-drains you outright — force the fight on your first-item spike instead.

notes: Both packet suspect names ('Use Sanguine Pool', 'His Transfusion') are false positives — correct names with a leading word. The content layer for this matchup is already at the quality bar and was left almost untouched; the work here was the full layer's boilerplate and the level chart, which contradicted its own explanations on four of seven rows.
